title: Wendell and the Border
author: Xanthe Galloway
blurb: Dominic Yarrow, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
